tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Shanghai Masters round of 16: Medvedev–Tsitsipas and Ruud–Auger-Aliassime headline Wednesday while Wuhan sees Swiatek and Kartal through • [SQUASH] Sivasangari rallies from two games down for her first PSA Diamond semi at the CIB Egyptian Open; Gohar and ElSherbini renew their rivalry at the Pyramids • [BADMINTON] Denmark Open: Yvonne Li shocks P.V. Sindhu after a last-minute main-draw call-up; Srikanth and Tanvi Sharma advance in Odense • [PICKLEBALL] Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open hits pro round of 32 Wednesday with senior amateur brackets also on court • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Montpellier opens Oct. 27 as the next elite stop; Wang Manyu and Sora Matsushima lead post–China Smash rankings

newsItems.title: Shanghai & Wuhan Roll On
newsItems.excerpt: ATP Shanghai’s round of 16 features Medvedev vs Tsitsipas and Ruud vs Auger-Aliassime, while WTA Wuhan saw Iga Swiatek and Sonay Kartal post opening wins.

newsItems.title: Li Stuns Sindhu in Odense
newsItems.excerpt: Germany’s Yvonne Li beat P.V. Sindhu 13-21, 25-23, 21-19 at the VICTOR Denmark Open after driving from Hamburg when promoted off the reserve list.

newsItems.title: Virginia Beach Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour’s Mojo Energy Pouches Virginia Beach Open moves to the pro round of 32 Wednesday, with senior amateur divisions also starting at Pickleball Virginia Beach.

newsItems.title: Montpellier Next on WTT Calendar
newsItems.excerpt: Elite singles return Oct. 27 at WTT Champions Montpellier after Wang Manyu defended China Smash and Sora Matsushima held the men’s No. 1 spot in Beijing.
